text:
Hi Dan,

Great to make your acquaintance over email. Drew pointed me in your
direction to finalise details of the attached order form. Appreciating that
Caption's priority is to start collecting the next round of data on a short
timeline and we cannot begin the training of the new team members until we
have signature so keep to get this squared off quickly.

Regarding the 21 month extension, we pushed heavily on Captions having this
flexibility of ramp up/ramp down of resources internally (as this is not
something we usually offer). Our standard term is typically 24 months for
all engagements & in our prior order form we again made a dispensation for
Captions.

Unlike crowd sourcing annotators, we procure FTEs and invest in their
training leading to both higher quality results and faster results.We
therefore require the 21 months to maintain the agreement to lower to 3
FTEs temporarily & temporarily increase to 7FTEs with a notice period.

If Captions would like to avoid committing to a 12 month term
extension (moving to 21months) we could move to 5 FTEs (4 additional FTEs)
without this flexibility - however we would still require a 12month
contract (extending the current contract by ~3 months) for such a material
change in annotators due to this investment.

I've put some time in for us tomorrow to go through any outstanding
questions at 10am EST, however, I am also available at 9am, 11am or 1pm if
